text:
sara: Quick check — Orchard customer cutover is tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need confirmations on egress mirror + firewall owners. Planned smoke window 09:00-09:30. @mike @anita :calendar:

mike: I can own the firewall rules. Need the final IP ranges from infra team. Have they posted the list?

anita: I'll coordinate infra IP list. FYI pkg mirror URL is ready in s3://orchard-mirror, but we need an nginx proxy in the DMZ. @kevin can you confirm?

kevin: Can do. I have a draft nginx conf. Need to know if we allow TLS upstream or terminate at proxy — leaning terminate at proxy. Also will open ports 443 outbound to internal repo hosts.

lia: Security needs explicit approved CIDR. We approved 10.240.0.0/16 for internal nodes; but DMZ egress must be locked to 52.32.10.0/24 (customer firewall). I updated the runbook and added a checklist item for HSM/KMS access proof. :lock:

sara: Ownership summary: firewall = mike, mirror+proxy = kevin, security signoff = lia, rollback owner = anita. @deploy-bot please schedule canary at 09:10.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary 09:10 PT, window 20m, will notify on failure. (automated)

mike: One blocker: the customer's airgap appliance doesn't have ca-certificates package. We need to either bundle certs or disable upstream TLS during initial bootstrap. Proposal: bundle certs and set up local trust store. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

anita: Bundling sounds safer. I can create a small RPM and add to mirror. Need a reviewer for the RPM spec. @kevin?

kevin: I'll review. Quick note: nginx proxy needs to inject Host header rewrite for upstream; sample config snippet:

```
server {
  listen 443 ssl;
  location / {
    proxy_pass https://internal-repo;
    proxy_set_header Host internal-repo.local;
  }
}
```

lia: Confirmed we can allow that host header change from compliance POV.

sara: Ok. mike, can you add the firewall change as a PR to infra repo? small snippet for iptables and terraform security group. Then @anita will trigger the deploy.

mike: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2245 — includes SG change, mark me as reviewer if anything.

anita: Reviewing now. LGTM aside from one comment about terraform var naming. Will merge after fix and kick off canary. :eyes:

sara: Last: ensure on-call rotation for the window. Kevin primary, Mike backup, Lia on async. Everybody ok?

kevin: ok

mike: ok

lia: ok

deploy-bot: canary started 09:10 PT — smoke tests running (automated).

anita: smoke green at 09:15, trace latency within SLA. No pkg errors.

sara: Perfect. Thanks team :tada: Will follow up with a short cutover blameless note and link to runbook updates.
